'''Syr Tal-Soten''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He came under the sway of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] on a search mission for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kirlocca]] in the [[Almas Wasteland]]s.

==Biography==
Discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] near birth, Syr Tal-Soten was taken to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. After passing through one of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi academy|academies]] and passing his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] after spending time as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], Tal-Soten was made a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="LFC" />

Stationed at the [[Almas Academy|academy]] on [[Almas]] under Headmaster [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]], Tal-Soten served the Order proudly and continued his studies in the Force. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Tal-Soten was at the Academy when a group of terrorists attacked the [[Remembrance Hall]]. Master Qel-Bertuk issued an order to all Jedi, demanding they return to the Academy; however, Master [[Kirlocca]] and his charges do not respond from their location in the [[Almas Wasteland]]. Qel-Bertuk then assembled a team of Jedi, led by [[Tantron Dow]], and including his Padawan [[Alkin Saad]], Jedi [[Trevon Rey]], [[Seeth'tal]], and Tal-Soten to located and escort Kirlocca and his students back to the academy. While the team wandered through the wastelands, Tal-Soten received a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of Master Kirlocca's betrayal of the Order, and all present became convinced of this inevitable occurrence. In fact, the Jedi had been affected by the strong surge in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] that was present in the wastelands, and they all had become deranged. Crashing their shuttle in the wastelands, the crazed rescue team continued on foot on their hunt for Kirlocca.<ref name="LFC" />

Having lost contact with the academy, Qel-Bertuk sent out another search team to recover the first and Master Kirlocca. The second team discovered the downed shuttle being picked apart by [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] salvagers and stop to search it. Inside they discover Padawan Saad's body and the confused and frantic [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] Master Dow. After calming the crazed Jedi, he directs them down the path Jedi Tal-Soten and the others had gone in search of Kirlocca. Arriving at Kirlocca's abandoned campsite where Tal-Soten and his group had killed a Jedi and injured Padawan [[Hary'nkel]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] girl reveals that Tal-Soten and his group had attacked them and the others had fled further into the wastes. Following the sounds of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], the second search party comes across Jedi Tal-Soten engaged in fighting Kirlocca and his surviving campers. The search party quickly help subdue Rey, Seeth'tal, and Sal-Toten, all of whom were taken back to the academy for evaluation and possibly return to the light side.<ref name="LFC" />
